title: Correct displacement expression
description: Essential: Student provides the correct SHM expression, including amplitude, angular frequency, and initial phase from the graph.

title: Correct displacement at t1
description: Essential: Student calculates and states the correct displacement at t=0.25e-2 s.

title: Correct distance traveled
description: Essential: Student calculates and states the correct total distance traveled from t=0 to t=8.5e-2 s.

title: Correct net displacement
description: Essential: Student calculates and states the correct net displacement from t=0 to t=8.5e-2 s.

title: Graph parameter extraction
description: Important: Student correctly extracts amplitude, period, and initial phase from the provided displacement-time graph.

title: Distance calculation reasoning
description: Important: Student correctly relates the time interval to a multiple of the period to calculate total distance traveled.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units (cm) throughout the solution and includes them in final answers.

title: Sign error in phase
description: Pitfall: Student makes an error in the sign of the initial phase constant (e.g., uses +π/2 instead of -π/2).

title: Distance vs. displacement confusion
description: Pitfall: Student confuses total distance traveled with net displacement for part (3).
